rate_source.notes: No employee_id or worker-specific rate rows; four employee contribution rates are owned by the Excel mapping sheet

effective_dating: Issue a new deduction_code when statutory contribution rates or calculation bases change; validate official effective period before applying
limitations: Contract base_pay alone cannot determine the insurance assessment bases
No statutory amounts, eligibility, exemptions or collection notices computed
Employer-only worker compensation insurance is not employee deduction
Unspecified rounding, insured status, bases, ceilings or relief means BLOCKED/REVIEW, never silently zero
Does not handle income tax or local income tax
